The **Rippa R32 PRO** is a high-performance, professional mini excavator, ideal for large construction projects, deep excavation work, and demanding earthmoving operations. With its combination of massive power, precise control, and robust design, it’s the perfect choice for professionals who value efficiency and durability.

Powered by a strong **Kubota diesel engine**, the R32 PRO delivers outstanding performance with an **operating weight of 3,375 kg**, a **digging depth of 2.83 meters**, and a **digging force of 27 kN** – ensuring maximum productivity for every task.

### Standard features include:

✔ 40 cm toothed bucket for precise digging

✔ Powerful Kubota diesel engine (Euro 5 certified)

✔ High digging force for heavy-duty excavation work

✔ Robust design for long-lasting professional use

Additional accessories, such as various buckets, grapples, or quick couplers, can be found in the **“ [Accessories](https://rippa-europe.com/collections/r32 "Accessoires")”** section on our website.
